execution_contract_recommendation.initial_api: synchronous /api/v1/chat/completions with local rendered images as base64; not raw 12-band GeoTIFF
execution_contract_recommendation.provider_policy_note: This combination is a proposed strict eligibility filter, not evidence that any candidate has an eligible endpoint. Fail closed if no permitted endpoint exists. Verify underlying provider/model terms separately for intended training use.
execution_contract_recommendation.response: JSON schema strict true plus local JSONSchema validation; record invalid/missing answers rather than silently repairing
execution_contract_recommendation.cost: Use actual usage.cost in each response and generation lookup for reconciliation. Measure a small fixed calibration set before projecting volume. Keep an API-key credit cap and local KRW cap, including exchange-rate/fees margin; no automatic top-up.
execution_contract_recommendation.limits: Do not infer guaranteed concurrency from model selection. Honor Retry-After and upstream errors; account/key/in-flight spending limits can yield 402 even with positive balance.
execution_contract_recommendation.privacy: ZDR and data_collection policies are distinct. Disable optional full prompt/response observability and separate data-sharing settings if retained prompts are inappropriate; maintain local provenance instead. No account settings were read or changed. Privacy options are candidate policies, not an assertion of an available compatible endpoint.
